partner_rule: learned operator whose absolute cosine to the target is closest to the target-specific median

hypotheses.P1_analytic_tensor_jvp_predicts_finite_c: For every target and half, analytic versus finite Fisher-cosine geometry has Spearman correlation at least 0.95 and diagonal rank correlation at least 0.98.
hypotheses.P2_first_order_attention_path_program_is: For every target and half, the direct plus all single-attention-insertion paths recover at least 0.90 of the exact analytic Fisher response by squared-error fidelity and at least 0.90 Fisher-cosine-geometry correlation.
hypotheses.P3_identity_only_is_not_sufficient: At least one target has identity-only Fisher-response fidelity below 0.90 on both halves.
hypotheses.P4_path_importance_is_split_stable: For every target, candidate-aggregated individual path energies have Spearman correlation at least 0.80 across halves.
hypotheses.P5_tensor_predictor_beats_raw_operator_g: For every target and half, analytic diagonal rank correlation with finite KL exceeds raw delta-norm rank correlation by at least 0.30.
hypotheses.P6_prediction_is_not_one_target_specific: P1 and P2 pass independently for all three prospectively fixed targets spanning Layers 0, 2, and 5.
